note: August closed at 2,152 bookings against a 4,718 target. The targets are strategic and deliberately aggressive, so the variance is by design, but the year-on-year is the real signal at -25.8 percent. Hutong Miami and Hutong NYC both moved their Google Reserve booking provider to OpenTable in March, so part of that fall is a routing change rather than lost demand. Aqua NYC is the conversion case: traffic is ahead of last year and bookings are not.
